bio.text: Bruce Westerman represents Arkansas's Fourth Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and chairs the Committee on Natural Resources.
A native of Hot Springs, he is an engineer and forester who worked 22 years at Mid-South Engineering.
He earned a B.S. in Biological and Agricultural Engineering from the University of Arkansas and a Master of Forestry from Yale University.
He served two terms in the Arkansas General Assembly, where he was House Majority Leader.
